with_wm.cause: the target GTK client window is reparented into an openbox frame; xcompmgr redirects the frame (a direct root child), not the client window, so NameWindowPixmap on the client window is a Match error

without_wm.note: a WM-less session makes the client a root child, but wire.windows() then fails; needs more work

listing_requirement.windows(): reads the root property _NET_CLIENT_LIST (EWMH); without a WM it is absent and the call fails with desktop_x11_window_list_unavailable
listing_requirement.capture_requirement: Composite NameWindowPixmap requires the target client window itself to be redirected
listing_requirement.conclusion: the implementation assumes a compositing WM (Mutter/KWin/compiz) that both advertises _NET_CLIENT_LIST and redirects client windows; openbox+xcompmgr reparents and redirects the frame only, so neither the WM-less nor openbox-xcompmgr setup can produce a capture
listing_requirement.next: install a compositing WM (mutter or kwin) with vkms in the VM, or verify on a real GNOME/KDE X11 desktop
